In the slides we used the *Motor Trend Cars* data (`mtcars`) to ask whether quarter-mile time depends upon engine shape and transmission. Today we stay with those cars but change the question to fuel economy. The comments in each chunk lay out the steps; fill in the code beneath them, and answer the questions in your own words.

```{r}
#| message: false
library( tidyverse )
```

## The Data

`mtcars` is built into R. It has 32 cars, and the three columns we need are `mpg` (miles per gallon), `cyl` (the number of cylinders: 4, 6, or 8), and `am` (the transmission: `0` is automatic and `1` is manual).

```{r}
data( mtcars )
head( mtcars )
```
